idea-plugin.name: ApiDoc
idea-plugin.description:
ApiDoc generates ShowDoc-style API Markdown documents from Java Spring MVC Controllers.

Features:

  • Generate API documentation from Controller classes or individual endpoint methods.
  • Parse request URLs, HTTP methods, request parameters, response parameters, and JavaDoc comments.
  • Extract current version information from Git branches.
  • Edit generated Markdown and preview it in real time.
  • Copy, export, batch copy, and batch export generated documents.
  • Support Chinese and English UI/document templates.
  • Support JSON formatting, copy buttons for URL/code/table content, and table-friendly Excel copying.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial Marketplace release.
  • Support generating ShowDoc-style Markdown from Spring MVC Controllers.
  • Support live preview, configurable themes, and preview font size.
  • Support excluding parent-class fields and specific fields.
  • Support Chinese and English UI.
